summary: Owner #1113 adopts existing-in-re -> act of esse -> concrete, but not arbitrary legacy Ontic assignments. New profile retains ontology and grounding exactly and fixes concrete to HasEsseInRe. Derive C from existing E plus ExistingInActAt, then import and compose inhabited-world, ancestry-fork, necessary-ancestor and same-witness essence Solutions using that same criterion; the final composition uses the q3 profile's own InAct/esse. Existing generic Challenges and omission models are untouched. actualConcreteGround_iff shows that with this contract actual existence plus the original grounding edge suffices; the concrete guard adds no further restriction. Distinct operation route: existing q75 OperationOnlyOfBeingInActReading is causation-only, so applying it to thinking was rejected. The additional conditional bearerConcreteOfOperation instead exposes occurrence-to-intellectual-exercise and intellectual-exercise-to-act interfaces, plus ActualityOnlyInsofarAsBeingReading. These analyst interfaces are not new root premises; exact source attribution is deferred. No source, passage or claim added. No occurrence, existence bridge, grounding premise or floor item is established by these connections. Computed initial frontier delta: one root-reaching bare premise C becomes conditionally proved, no bare premise added, every route cost unchanged (cheapest 31). See docs/notes/cogito-esse-1113.md.
blocker: The adopted selected-world interpretation contract and occurrence-to-existence bridge remain explicit premises, not independently established floor items. Using the operation route as a separately recorded root derivation would need justification/interpretation of its intellectual-exercise interfaces; q75's causation-only existing reading does not supply them.
